sourceAuthorities: social gameplay and NPC interaction instructions

resolvedFindings.finding: Social source contains forty-nine detailed Action forms but alpha scope needs a bounded runtime.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require seven minimum alpha Actions while preserving all forms as registry-ready source coverage.

resolvedFindings.finding: Source DC examples could be mistaken for global constants.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Bind them only through versioned resolution profiles.

resolvedFindings.finding: Thirty-eight source commands and thirty-one Events cross several domain authorities.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Separate Social lifecycle ownership, shared proposal operations, and delegated domain Event adapters.

resolvedFindings.finding: Social outcome groups require undo but history must remain durable.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Use atomic Event groups and compensating undo Events; never delete history.

resolvedFindings.finding: NPC truth, belief, Player belief, lies, rumors, motives, mood, intent, and stance overlap linguistically.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Lock distinct records/fields and role-safe projections.

resolvedFindings.finding: Social UI could bypass inventory, clue, access, relationship, standing, or combat authority.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require owning-domain validation/adapters within one atomic coordinator.

resolvedFindings.finding: AI drafting could become irreversible NPC control.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Keep AI optional, role-filtered, draft-only, and GM-mediated with no final authority.
